# JRE #2326 — Jimmy Carr

Joe Rogan welcomed British comedian Jimmy Carr to the podcast on May 22, 2025, for a conversation with one of comedy's sharpest and most provocative voices. Carr, known for his distinctive deadpan delivery and willingness to tackle controversial subject matter, came to discuss his recent Netflix special "Jimmy Carr: Natural Born Killer" and his current touring schedule.

Jimmy Carr has built a remarkable career spanning stand-up comedy, television hosting, and writing. His work has earned him recognition as one of the most intellectually rigorous comedians working today. Beyond his stand-up material, Carr has hosted multiple television programs and maintained an active presence in the entertainment industry across both sides of the Atlantic. His Netflix special represents his latest major release, showcasing the material and perspective he's been developing in recent years.

During the episode, Carr discussed his approach to comedy and the current state of stand-up performance. As someone who has continuously pushed boundaries throughout his career, he represents a particular strain of comedy that prioritizes intelligent humor over mass appeal. His comedy often draws on his background in philosophy and his analytical approach to social and political topics. The conversation touched on his work as a performer and creator, allowing listeners insight into how he constructs his material and approaches his craft.

The episode also covered Carr's touring activities, giving fans information about where they could see him perform live. For those interested in his recent work, Carr promoted his Netflix special "Jimmy Carr: Natural Born Killer," which showcases his current comedic voice and represents a substantial body of his recent material. This special serves as a definitive statement of where Carr stands artistically at this point in his career.

Joe and Jimmy's conversation fell within the typical JRE format, allowing the guest space to discuss his background, current projects, and perspective on various aspects of comedy and entertainment. The episode benefited from Rogan's interviewing style, which tends to dig into guests' experiences and allow extended exploration of topics that interest them.

The episode featured sponsorships from ExpressVPN and BetterHelp, reflecting the standard podcast advertising landscape. These sponsors represent the types of products and services commonly featured on the show during its advertisements.

For fans of intelligent comedy and those curious about one of Britain's most distinctive comedic voices, this episode offered an extended conversation with someone who has spent decades refining his craft and developing a unique perspective on entertainment and social commentary. Jimmy Carr's appearance provided an opportunity for Joe Rogan's audience to engage with a comedian whose work stands apart from mainstream comedy through its intellectual rigor and willingness to explore complex and sometimes uncomfortable topics. The episode served as promotion for Carr's Netflix special while also functioning as a broader conversation about comedy, performance, and the current entertainment landscape.
